title: Plato Hydrometer Reading Plato Leaderboard
dataSources: Fermentation gravity/temperature (`brew:fermentation`), kegerator pours (`kegerator:pour`), wine-cellar climate (`winecellar:reading`).
app: Fermentation sensors (Tilt/iSpindel hydrometer, temperature), kegerator flow meters and scales, and wine-cellar climate sensors via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=plato:reading plato=*
| stats sum(plato) as total_value, avg(plato) as avg_value by batch_id
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks batch values by total and average plato across Plato hydrometer reading events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `plato` values for each Plato hydrometer reading event and review total and average plato by batch.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total plato.
grandmaExplanation: It usefully which batch shows the biggest plato numbers in your Plato hydrometer reading data.
